subject: en
source: English National Curriculum — English programmes of study: key stage 1 (Year 1 writing, vocabulary, grammar and punctuation; Appendix 2), DfE 2013

weeks.topic: Handwriting: sitting correctly, pencil grip and letter formation
objectives: Sit correctly and hold a pencil comfortably
Form lower-case letters starting in the right place

weeks.topic: Labels and captions: all about me
objectives: Write labels for a picture of myself
Write a simple caption using phonics

weeks.topic: Saying a sentence aloud before writing it
objectives: Compose a sentence orally before writing it
Count the words in a spoken sentence

weeks.topic: Capital letters for names and the pronoun I
objectives: Use a capital letter for names of people and places
Use a capital letter for the personal pronoun I

weeks.topic: Finger spaces and full stops
objectives: Leave finger spaces between words
End a sentence with a full stop

weeks.topic: Recount: my weekend in order
objectives: Write sentences about my weekend in order
Use time words: first, next, then, finally

weeks.topic: Stories with familiar settings: story maps
objectives: Retell a familiar story using a story map
Talk about the setting of a story

weeks.topic: Joining words and clauses with and
objectives: Join two ideas using and
Write longer sentences with and

weeks.topic: Plural nouns with -s and -es
objectives: Add -s or -es to make plurals
Use singular and plural in sentences

weeks.topic: Instructions: bossy verbs
objectives: Write simple instructions for making a sandwich
Start each instruction with a bossy verb

weeks.topic: Poetry: rhyme and repeated patterns
objectives: Join in with and learn nursery rhymes
Write a new verse using a repeated pattern

weeks.topic: Question marks: asking questions
objectives: Write questions to ask a character
End questions with a question mark

weeks.topic: Traditional tales: describing characters (Goldilocks)
objectives: Describe a character using simple adjectives
Write sentences about what a character does

weeks.topic: Letters and cards: writing a festive card
objectives: Write a short card or letter to someone
Begin with Dear and end with From

weeks.topic: Review: capital letters, full stops and recounts
objectives: Revisit capital letters, finger spaces and full stops
Write a short recount independently

weeks.topic: Exclamation marks: surprise and strong feelings
objectives: Use an exclamation mark to show surprise or strong feeling
Read sentences with expression

weeks.topic: Suffixes -ing, -ed and -er on verbs
objectives: Add -ing, -ed and -er to verbs with no change to the root word
Use them in sentences

weeks.topic: The prefix un-
objectives: Add un- to change the meaning of words (unkind, undo)
Use un- words in sentences

weeks.topic: Non-chronological report: animals
objectives: Write facts about an animal under headings
Use a picture with labels

weeks.topic: Stories by the same author: writing a new ending
objectives: Read stories by Julia Donaldson
Write a new ending for one of the stories

weeks.topic: Writing in the past tense
objectives: Retell an event using past tense verbs
Spot past tense verbs ending in -ed

weeks.topic: Sequencing sentences to form short narratives
objectives: Write a beginning, middle and end
Put sentences in an order that makes sense

weeks.topic: Poetry: a senses poem
objectives: Write a poem using the five senses
Perform a poem to the class

weeks.topic: Information texts: a minibeast fact file
objectives: Find facts about a minibeast
Write a fact file with headings and sentences

weeks.topic: Traditional tales: changing The Three Little Pigs
objectives: Change the characters or setting of a traditional tale
Write the new version in sentences

weeks.topic: Re-reading writing to check it makes sense
objectives: Re-read my own sentences aloud
Fix missing words and punctuation

weeks.topic: Mid-year writing assessment
objectives: Write sentences with capital letters and full stops
Use and to join ideas
Write a short narrative or recount

weeks.topic: Handwriting: capital letters and digits 0–9
objectives: Form capital letters correctly
Form digits 0–9 correctly

weeks.topic: Diary entry: writing as a character
objectives: Write a diary entry using I and past tense
Describe how the character feels

weeks.topic: Postcards: describing a place
objectives: Write a postcard describing a holiday place
Use describing words for places

weeks.topic: Adventure stories: planning with a story map
objectives: Plan a journey story with a story map
Write the story using time words

weeks.topic: Instructions: numbered steps for a recipe
objectives: Write a recipe with a list of ingredients
Write numbered steps starting with bossy verbs

weeks.topic: Grammar terms: letter, word, sentence, singular, plural
objectives: Use the words letter, word and sentence correctly
Sort nouns into singular and plural

weeks.topic: Reading my writing aloud to others
objectives: Read my writing aloud clearly to a partner or the class
Listen and give a kind comment

weeks.topic: Independent writing: a story about a journey
objectives: Write a short story independently
Use capital letters, full stops and and

weeks.topic: End-of-year writing assessment
objectives: Write a narrative with a beginning, middle and end
Use correct sentence punctuation
Spell common exception words

weeks.topic: Year 1 review: my best writing
objectives: Choose and share my best piece of writing
Revisit punctuation and suffixes learnt in Year 1
